summary: This rule redirects any URL starting with 'archive/2020/' to just '2020/', keeping whatever comes after the date intact. It's a permanent redirect (301) that helps maintain SEO value when you reorganize your site's folder structure.

explanations.1: The caret (^) means 'start of the URL' and the dollar sign ($) means 'end of the URL', so this only matches paths that begin with exactly 'archive/2020/'. The parentheses capture whatever comes after into a numbered group we can reuse. R=301 tells the browser this is a permanent move, NC ignores uppercase/lowercase differences, and L stops processing any further rules.
